findings.issue_text: app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/topic-post.scss:291 — [P2 advisory, confidence 100] `color: dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%));` duplicates the theme-aware inverse-lightness calculation across every selector instead of centralizing it in a one-argument helper, and the resulting hand-maintained parallel values have already drifted here from the original 30% light-theme value, so each future color adjustment requires two synchronized edits at every call site and can silently regress one theme; although direct calls appear locally explicit, the observed parameter reversal proves that explicitness does not preserve the invariant, while a helper deletes the repeated secondary expression and its second percentage from all call sites.

app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/_topic-list.scss:115 — P1, confidence 100: `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%);` leaves category notification badges derived from `$primary` in dark themes, so the stated requirement is not implemented for this selector.

app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/topic-post.scss:291 — P2, confidence 100: `color: dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%));` changes the light-theme branch from the pre-change 30% lightness to 70%, making user links substantially lighter even though the task only requires a dark-theme correction.

app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/modal.scss:102 — P2, confidence 100: `color: dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%));` changes the light-theme branch from the pre-change 70% lightness to 30%, making the custom-message length indicator substantially darker outside the requested dark-theme behavior.

app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/user.scss:522 — P2, confidence 100: `color: dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%));` changes the light-theme name color from the pre-change 30% lightness to 50%, regressing the existing light-theme presentation while implementing the dark-theme requirement.

app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/topic-post.scss:182 — P2, confidence 100: `color: dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%));` changes the light-theme topic-map heading from the pre-change 20% lightness to 50%, reducing its established contrast outside the requested dark-theme behavior.
